The time-shifting property states that if $g(t) \leftrightarrow G(\omega)$, then $g(t - t_0) \leftrightarrow e^{-j\omega t_0} G(\omega)$.
Here, $t_0 = 3$.
Let's define a function $g(t)$ such that $f(t) = g(t - 3)$.
$f(t) = e^{-2t} \sin(6(t - 3)) u(t - 3)$.
